proposedReleaseChecks.label: Deterministic governance checks. These are not a factual-quality evaluation or real payer validation.

checks.name: Content screening
checks.explanation: Document instructions remain untrusted. Recognized injection content is quarantined.

checks.name: Document identity
checks.explanation: Source name, document type, version, owner and program must be reviewed.

checks.name: Applicability metadata
checks.explanation: Every applicability dimension needs a reviewed value or explicit not-applicable scope.

checks.name: Synthetic case match
checks.explanation: A release assigned to this case must match its product, payer, plan, geography and benefit.

checks.name: Effective dates
checks.explanation: The source must be effective and unexpired at this synthetic checkpoint.

checks.name: Audience and permitted use
checks.explanation: This SC-01 case requires explicit HCP/chat/recommend scope. Channel permission never grants an effect.

checks.name: Reviewer attribution
checks.explanation: The Knowledge Reviewer must be explicitly identified. The contributor cannot self-approve.

checks.name: Source authority
checks.explanation: The reviewer must attest the synthetic source’s authority domain.

checks.name: Reviewed facts
checks.explanation: Each proposed fact needs a reviewed kind, value and exact passage quote.

checks.name: Superseded source
checks.explanation: A proposed predecessor must identify an existing approved governed source. Publication does not itself supersede it.

checks.name: Internal consistency
checks.explanation: Conflicting assertions require correction before publication.

knowledgeStudio.retention: Unapproved original files, extracted passages and sandbox tests expire with this four-hour session.
